source_sections: • Built Python and FastAPI services with PostgreSQL transactions, typed request validation, and repeatable integration tests for fictional orders.
• Implemented RAG retrieval and evals over synthetic documents, recording grounded answers and regression cases before Docker deployment.
• Built TypeScript interfaces and Python API clients, documenting schema changes and debugging sandbox integrations with fictional users.
• Packaged Docker development environments and PostgreSQL migrations with rollback notes and structured error logging for reproducible releases.
Sandbox Connector: Built an MCP tool server with typed inputs, explicit local permissions, and synthetic fixture tests for document lookup.
Evaluation Notebook: Compared RAG retrieval settings on a fixed synthetic corpus and documented evals, failure cases, and reproducible experiment inputs.
Languages and backend: Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL
Tools and methods: Docker, RAG, evals, MCP, integration tests
